title: ISO/IEC 42005:2025 — AI Impact Assessment Implementation Guide
hook: ISO published Jan 2025; UK adoption via BSI PAS expected Q4 2026
answer_first: ISO/IEC 42005 provides structured AI impact assessment methodology across seven dimensions (human rights, fairness, physical/psychological safety, privacy, environmental, economic). It is the implementation guide for 42001 certification holders and maps directly to the EU AI Act FRIA requirement under Article 27.
council_positioning: Monitored containment, not provable isolation. Verified measurement credential. UK-sovereign, AUKUS-compatible.
